scripts.images: ../../node_modules/.bin/agent-tool --repo ../.. images build favicons --out packages/website/public && ../../node_modules/.bin/agent-tool --repo ../.. images build social
scripts.build:staging: bun run images && astro build --mode staging
scripts.build:production: bun run images && astro build --mode production
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: bun run build:production && wrangler deploy --env production
